name: vscode-resource-guardian
description: Monitors and mitigates VS Code zygote process runaway CPU/memory issues, extension host memory leaks, and Electron resource contention

commands.title: Resource Guardian: EMERGENCY Cleanup (Kill All Runaway Processes)

resourceGuardian.monitorInterval.description: Interval in milliseconds to check resource usage (default: 30000ms = 30s, was 5s - too aggressive)

resourceGuardian.cpuThreshold.description: CPU usage threshold (%) for zygote/utility processes before warning (default: 25%, was 10% - caught normal processes)

resourceGuardian.memoryThreshold.description: Memory threshold (MB) for zygote/utility processes before warning (default: 800MB, was 400MB - too low)

resourceGuardian.extensionHostMemoryThre.description: Memory threshold (MB) for extension host before warning (default: 600MB, was 400MB - too low)

resourceGuardian.autoKillRunaway.description: Automatically kill runaway zygote processes (DANGEROUS: may cause instability)

resourceGuardian.autoGarbageCollection.description: Automatically trigger garbage collection when memory threshold exceeded

resourceGuardian.logToFile.description: Log resource metrics to file for analysis

resourceGuardian.alertOnSwap.description: Alert when system is using swap memory (indicates memory pressure)
